lemma mem_or_inv_mem_closure_baseOf [Finite ι] [InvolutiveInv ι] [CommGroup S] [IsOrderedMonoid S]

  · right
    exact Submonoid.subset_closure ⟨i⁻¹, by simpa [hv_inv]⟩
  · left
    exact Submonoid.subset_closure ⟨i, by simpa⟩
